# 1. Overview

This notebook documents the R implementation of the quantitative analysis
behind *Simulated Code-Convergence in Synthetic Vocal Performance*
(P. Merrikhi). The pipeline (a) ingests frame-level acoustic features,
(b) recomputes the S1–S4 segment summary, (c) quantifies F0-variance
shrinkage (raw vs pitch-corrected) and checks it against the ratios
reported in the paper (raw ≈ 2.11×, pitch-corrected ≈ 1.62×), and
(d) computes the Code Co-Presence Index

$$CCI_s = 1 - \frac{|A - B|}{A + B}$$

for consecutive windows, testing whether code co-presence rises over time
(convergence).

# 2. Study constants

```{r constants}
SR         <- 16000L
DURATION_S <- 250.816
N_SEG      <- 4L
SEG_NAMES  <- paste0("S", 1:N_SEG)
HARMONIC_169_HZ <- 169
```

Audio duration: `r DURATION_S` s at `r SR` Hz, divided into
`r N_SEG` segments of ≈ 62.7 s each.

# 3. Data ingestion

Two equivalent ingestion paths are implemented:

* `01_load_data_csv.R` — reads the CSV exports shipped in `github_data/`
  (schema documented in `data_dictionary.csv`);
* `01b_load_data_npz.R` — reads the raw `feats.npz` / `f0.npy` / optional
  `features.npz` with **reticulate** and exports the same CSV copies.

```{r ingestion}
dat_csv <- "out/tables/dat_csv.rds"
dat_npz <- "out/tables/dat_npz.rds"
dat <- if (file.exists(dat_csv)) readRDS(dat_csv) else readRDS(dat_npz)
cat("master frames:", nrow(dat$master), "| feats frames:", nrow(dat$feats),
    "| voiced F0 frames:", sum(!is.na(dat$feats$f0_hz)),
    "| unvoiced:", sum(is.na(dat$feats$f0_hz)), "\n")
head(dat$feats)
```

# 4. Segment-level acoustic summary

```{r summary}
summ <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "acoustic_summary_r.csv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
knitr::kable(summ, digits = 2,
```

# 5. Variance analysis

```{r ratios}
ratios <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "variance_ratios.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
trends <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "variance_trends.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
knitr::kable(ratios, digits = 3,
             caption = "S1/S4 variance ratios (raw and pitch-corrected)")
knitr::kable(trends, digits = 3,
             caption = "Trend tests across S1-S4")
```

```{r fig-variance, echo=FALSE}

knitr::include_graphics(file.path(OUT_FIG, "fig2_f0_by_segment.png"))

```

# 6. Code Co-Presence Index (CCI_s)

```{r cci}
cci_res <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "cci_window_results.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
seg_cci <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "cci_segment_summary.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
conv    <- readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_TAB, "cci_convergence.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
knitr::kable(head(cci_res, 10), digits = 4,
             caption = "Per-window CCI_s (first 10 rows)")
knitr::kable(seg_cci, digits = 4,
             caption = "Mean CCI_s per segment")
knitr::kable(conv, digits = 4,
             caption = "Convergence tests across windows")
```

```{r fig-cci, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(OUT_FIG, "fig4_cci_trajectory.png"))
```

# 8. Checks against the paper

The recomputed raw and pitch-corrected ratios are compared with the paper
values (2.11× and 1.62×) inside `03_variance_analysis.R`; a mismatch larger
than 10 % produces a warning. All tables and figures are written under
`out/` for direct inclusion in the manuscript.
